name: theaetetus
description: Human-led dialectical inquiry with a fallible AI oracle and bounded coaching.

interface.shortDescription: Interrogate a fallible oracle; keep the model.
interface.longDescription: Run a persistent, human-led inquiry that builds and tests a causal model, preserves evidence provenance in a workpad, and recruits bounded coaching only when the questioning process needs repair.
defaultPrompt: Start a dialectical inquiry about a decision I need to understand.
Help me interrogate this AI answer without taking over the inquiry.
Coach one weak move in how I questioned this oracle.
